extraction_notes: Digitised main-text plots that report NH3 synthesis rate. Isotopic mass-signal plots in Figures 6 and 7, TPD/XRD/optical/structural panels, and schematic Figure 9 were not extracted because they do not plot NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF. In Figure 4d, literature/comparison bars not corresponding to the BaCeO3/BaCeO3−xNyHz catalysts of this paper were skipped. Near-baseline Co/BaCeO3 and Fe/BaCeO3 traces in Figure 4b are difficult to resolve; only the clearly legible 400 °C plotted endpoints were recorded.
